title: teamLab, Kappabashi, HANDS, Lawson dinner, early night
summary: teamLab Borderless first thing, coffee beside Tokyo Tower, Kappabashi, a look at the Skytree from the street, a book nook kit at HANDS, the Forum, then Lawson noodles and hot chicken, and back early to pack and watch Godzilla.

rows.detail: About 25 minutes on foot via Toranomon to Azabudai Hills. Taxi if it is wet.
Arrive a little early to be among the first in. Allow about two hours. The booking can change date or time up to three times.

rows.what: Sky Room Café & Bar, Mori JP Tower 34F
rows.detail: Coffee with Tokyo Tower right alongside. Open 09:00 to 21:00, no bookings. The 33F viewing area is ¥500 each plus a drink. Zōjō-ji, the temple below the tower, is 10 minutes' walk if you want it.

rows.what: Hibiya line, then the Ginza line to Tawaramachi
rows.detail: From Kamiyachō, Hibiya line to Ginza, change to the Ginza line to Tawaramachi (田原町), about 30 minutes.

Weekday, so the shops are open. Knives: Kama-asa (free engraving) and Kamata Hakensha. Ceramics: Dengama. Fake food: Ganso food samples. Niimi's giant chef head at the south end. Knives fly in checked bags only.

rows.what: Ganso Food Sample Shop, fake food
rows.detail: The fake food you see in restaurant windows, at the north end of Kappabashi-dōri: sushi, ramen and parfait replicas as magnets, keyrings and full-size pieces. They also run a make-your-own workshop at set times; ask in store if there is a spot today (普通は予約が必要です: usually booked ahead). Open 10:00 to 17:30.

rows.what: Spicy udon at Marugame Seimen, Asakusa
rows.detail: Quick bite on the way to the bridge. Spicy options on the board: 肉辛まぜうどん (spicy beef mixed udon, ¥890) or 旨辛豚つけ汁うどん (spicy pork dipping udon, ¥990). Grab tempura from the counter as you slide along, pay at the end.
A short walk over from Marugame for a photo of the temple, then on to the bridge.
From Sensō-ji, back out through Kaminarimon and east about 3 minutes to Azuma-bashi bridge (吾妻橋) for the Skytree across the river, with the golden Asahi flame. Asakusa station is at the bridge end.
Asakusa to Ginza, about 18 minutes, direct. Exit towards Marronnier-dōri.

rows.what: Book nook kit at HANDS Ginza
rows.detail: Floors 5 to 9 of Marronnier Gate Ginza 1. The hobby and craft floor has the miniature book nook kits. Ask: ブックヌックのキットはありますか？ Tax-free on 9F with passports. About 30 to 40 minutes.
Three minutes from HANDS, across the JR tracks at Yūrakuchō. The boat-shaped glass atrium by Rafael Viñoly. Lift to 7F and walk down the ramps. Free, about 20 minutes.

rows.what: Walked the lanes under the tracks back to the hotel
rows.detail: A look at the Yūrakuchō lanes and OKUROJI on the way back; dinner there later.

rows.what: Back at the hotel: book the taxi, AirPod, rest
rows.detail: At the desk: 明日の朝6時40分に羽田空港第3ターミナルまでタクシーを予約できますか？定額運賃でお願いします。 And: 京都のホテルから荷物が届いていますか？

rows.what: Dinner from Lawson: noodles and hot chicken
rows.detail: Convenience store noodles and hot chicken from a Lawson near the hotel. Then pack, Godzilla, early night. Set two alarms for 06:00.

notes: Ceramics and knives bought now go home without a trip through Kyoto. Knives fly in checked bags only. And the market on Tuesday comes before you are sushied out. Shops first as they close about 17:00, temple later as the crowds ease.
Tsukiji can come back here at 08:00 with teamLab moved to 13:30, and Asakusa returns to Tuesday 20. If teamLab moved for wet weather, start in Asakusa about 10:00.
